newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia Orient to place HK$72 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: Asia Orient to place HK$72 mln warrants.

text.p: Asia Orient Holdings Ltd said on Friday it has agreed to privately place 95 million to 112 million 1997-98 warrants, raising net proceeds of about HK$72 million to HK$85 million.
The company said the warrants would be placed to independent institutional and private investors at HK$0.80 per warrant.
The 1997-98 warrants entitle holders to subscribe to one Asia Orient share at an initial subscription price of HK$2.40 each before maturity on February 28, 1998.
Asia Orient shares ended at HK$2.925 on Thursday.
Between 95 million and 112 million new shares, representing 20 percent of the company's share capital, will be issued on exercise in full of the warrants, the company said.
Dealing in the warrants is expected to begin on February 14, it said.
The proceeds will be used to reduce bank borrowings and for working capital, Asia Orient said.
The company also said there were 478.29 million shares issued as of January 2 as well as 82.07 million outstanding warrants.
The outstanding warrants entitle holders to subscribe to one company share at HK$1.60 each before expiry on January 15.
Asia Orient engages in property investment and investment holdings. It specialises in the acquisition, management and realisation of undervalued assets.
